purpose: Subscription cancellation: stop future billing, preserve access to the end of the paid period, survive a flaky billing provider. This is the methodology's acceptance case — five sentences of prose turned into the decisions the prose leaves open.

excluded.reason: Product policy: no refunds for the unused period (DEC-001). Nothing here may issue one.
No mid-period price adjustment exists in this product.
Resubscribing creates a new subscription; owned by the signup area.
Retry-and-chase on failed renewal payments is the billing area's job.

entities.name: Subscription
entities.description: CLOSED: exactly these three states exist. 'Paused', 'PendingCancellation' and friends are the states an implementation invents when nobody wrote the list down — the marker is what stops that.

externals.name: BillingProvider
externals.description: Third-party recurring-billing API. Cancellation is only real once it accepts the request.

outcomes.name: DECLINED
outcomes.description: Provider refuses the change (e.g. account in arrears).

outcomes.name: TIMEOUT
outcomes.description: No answer within the deadline. The request may or may not have been applied.

outcomes.name: NETWORK_ERROR
outcomes.description: The call never reached the provider.

assumptions.statement: BillingProvider eventually responds to a cancellation request, within at most three retry windows.
assumptions.discharged_by: Synthetic cancellation probe every 5 minutes; pages if a request is unanswered for 15.

assumptions.statement: The paid period end is known locally and does not depend on the provider being reachable.

decisions.title: No refunds on cancellation
decisions.decision: Cancellation stops future billing and preserves access to the end of the paid period. No money is returned.
decisions.rationale: Product policy; the paid period has already been delivered as access.

alternatives_considered.option: Prorated refund of the unused days
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: Support and accounting cost outweighs the churn benefit at this price point.

states.name: Cancelled
states.description: Billing stopped; access survives to the end of the paid period.

open_questions.question: After MAX_CANCEL_RETRIES exhausted TIMEOUTs, does the subscription stay Active forever, or does an operator get paged? ASM-001 assumes the provider answers eventually; nothing here says what happens if it does not.
